_comment: Read by scripts/tokens.py. Weighted tokens = (input + 1.25*cache_write + 0.1*cache_read + 5*output) * model weight. window_budget 61M = calibrated from 2 past session-limit hits (Sep 24, Oct 23: 61.2M and 61.6M in the 5 h before). It is re-learned automatically from the first usage-limit hit (status/budget_state.json). Set it by hand if you know your plan's limit.
